title: Dealer Program Tier Guide: Tier Ladder, Entry Gates and Quarterly Review
content:
Every 3 months the dealer's tier under the Dealer Retail Agreements is set from the tier review basis — funded contracts and first-payment default rate over the 90 days ending on the review date: the dealer moves up one tier when its funded contracts and first-payment default rate meet the next tier's entry gate and it has had no watch or suspension status for 180 calendar days, and moves down one tier when it falls below its tier's minimum contracts for retention or above its tier's first-payment default limit; it never moves more than 1 tier at one review. A tier change applies to contracts funded after the review date only.

## The ladder

Rank 1 is the lowest tier.

| Rank | Dealer Program tier | Entry gate: funded contracts in the trailing 90 days, at least | Entry gate: first-payment default rate, at most (percent) | Funded contracts in the 90 days before a review needed to keep the tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Dealer Program Bronze | 0 | 8.0 | 0 |
| 2 | Dealer Program Silver | 15 | 7.0 | 10 |
| 3 | Dealer Program Gold | 40 | 6.0 | 30 |
| 4 | Dealer Program Platinum | 75 | 5.0 | 60 |
| 5 | Dealer Program Diamond | 120 | 4.5 | 100 |
| 6 | Dealer Program Elite | 200 | 4.0 | 170 |

For every tier: reviews take place every 3 months; the statistics a tier review uses are funded contracts and first-payment default rate over the 90 days ending on the review date; a dealer moves at most 1 tier up or down at one review; and 180 calendar days without a suspension or watch status are required before an upgrade.

## The two review measures

- **Funded contracts.** The count of the agreement's funded contracts in the 90 calendar days ending on the review date, inclusive.
- **First-payment default rate.** Of the agreement's contracts funded in the 90 calendar days ending 60 days before the review date, the percent whose first installment was not paid within the first-payment default period of its due date.

## Review outcomes (hypothetical dealers)

All figures below are hypothetical inputs for a dealer on Dealer Program Silver at a review.

| Funded contracts | First-payment default rate | Watch or suspension status in the last 180 days | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 52 | 5.5 percent | None | Meets the Gold entry gate (52 is at least 40; 5.5 is at most 6.0): moves up one tier to Dealer Program Gold |
| 80 | 4.8 percent | None | Meets the Gold gate (and the figures are also within the Platinum gate), but the dealer moves no more than 1 tier: Dealer Program Gold |
| 52 | 5.5 percent | Placed on watch 120 days before the review | The 180-day clean condition is unmet, so the upward move does not apply |
| 38 | 5.5 percent | None | 38 is below the Gold entry gate of 40, so the upward move does not apply |
| 8 | 5.5 percent | None | 8 is below the Silver retention minimum of 10: moves down one tier to Dealer Program Bronze |

## Effective date of a tier change

A tier change applies to contracts funded after the review date only. A contract funded on the review date itself, or before it, keeps the tier in force before the review; a contract funded on the day after the review date takes the new tier. The review records the tier after the review and the review date on the agreement.
